Rajasthan.title: Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund – Medical Help
benefits: Demand Draft or Direct Bank Transfer to beneficiary
Cochlear Implant Surgery support for deaf and mute children up to 6 years (income up to ₹2 lakh)
Thalassemia Major treatment assistance up to ₹50.7 lakh
Financial assistance for serious diseases like cancer, kidney, urinary and heart disease
Medical assistance in government and recognized private hospitals
eligibility: Applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan
Applicant should be Non-BPL
Annual family income should be more than ₹2 lakh
Applicant should not be covered under ABMGRSBY (Ayushman Bharat Mahatma Gandhi Rajasthan Swasthya Bima Yojana)
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal https://cmrf.rajasthan.gov.in/
Click on 'Apply for Medical Help'
Select 'Apply Online'
Fill personal, address and medical details
Upload medical certificates, doctor's reports and bills
Submit the application and note the acknowledgment number

faqs.q: Who can apply for Rajasthan Chief Minister’s Relief Fund?
faqs.a: Residents of Rajasthan who are Non-BPL and suffering from serious medical conditions can apply.

faqs.q: Is online application mandatory?
faqs.a: Yes, applications are accepted only through the official online portal.

faqs.q: How much financial assistance is provided?
faqs.a: The assistance amount depends on the disease and treatment, subject to government limits.

faqs.q: How can I check application status?
faqs.a: You can track your application using the acknowledgment number on the official website.

Rajasthan.title: Chief Minister Ekal Nari Samman Pension Yojana
benefits: ₹500 per month for women aged 18–55 years
₹750 per month for women aged 55–60 years
₹1000 per month for women aged 60–75 years
₹1500 per month for women above 75 years
Financial support to widowed, divorced and abandoned women for livelihood
eligibility: Applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan
Age should be 18 years or above
Applicant must be widowed, divorced or abandoned
Applicant should not have any regular source of income
Annual family income should be less than ₹48,000
Applicant should not be a government employee or pension holder
applicationProcess: Visit the official Rajasthan social security portal
Click on 'Apply Online'
Fill the application form with required details
Upload necessary documents
Submit the application and save the receipt
documentsRequired: Abandonment Certificate issued by competent authority

faqs.q: Who can get benefits under this scheme?
faqs.a: Widowed, divorced or abandoned women of Rajasthan with low income are eligible.

faqs.q: What is the minimum age for eligibility?
faqs.a: The minimum age is 18 years.

faqs.q: Can women from other states apply?
faqs.a: No, only permanent residents of Rajasthan are eligible.

faqs.q: Is a government employee eligible?
faqs.a: No, government employees or pension holders are not eligible.

faqs.q: How to apply for the scheme?
faqs.a: Applications can be submitted online through the official Rajasthan social security portal.

Rajasthan.title: Rajasthan Scheme for Study Abroad (Meritorious Girl Students)
Rajasthan.overview: The Rajasthan State Government provides an opportunity to meritorious girl students studying in government schools to pursue graduate-level education abroad for four years. This scheme is aimed at empowering talented girls through global education exposure.
benefits: Up to ₹30,000 for SAT coaching expenses per student
Up to ₹50,000 for SAT (Scholastic Aptitude Test) registration fee
₹25,000 assistance for applying to foreign universities
Full accommodation facility provided by the foreign university after admission
Economy class airfare for the student and one parental visit per year
Up to ₹10 lakh per year expenditure covered for each student during the 4-year course
eligibility: Applicant must be a girl student studying in a government school of Rajasthan
Must be among the top three girl students at the state level in Class 10th Board Examination
Board of Secondary Education, Rajasthan must recommend the candidate
Consent of father/guardian is mandatory
Only Rajasthan domicile students are eligible
applicationProcess: Visit the official education department web portal
Download the application form from page number 12 of the guideline
Fill the application form carefully in the prescribed format
Attach all required documents
Submit the completed application to the District Education Officer
Await selection and consent verification process
specialFacilities: SAT exam preparation facility available only in Jaipur
Student must take admission in Class 11 in a Jaipur-based school for SAT preparation
Hostel accommodation available at Government Girls Higher Secondary School, Malviya Nagar, Jaipur
Students may arrange their own accommodation if they do not wish to use hostel facility

faqs.q: What is the scope of this scheme?
faqs.a: The scheme allows meritorious girl students from Rajasthan government schools to pursue graduate-level education abroad.

faqs.q: Who can get the benefits under the scheme?
faqs.a: Top three girl students at the state level in Class 10th from government schools of Rajasthan.

faqs.q: Can students from other states apply?
faqs.a: No, only permanent residents of Rajasthan are eligible.

faqs.q: What is the qualification eligibility?
faqs.a: The applicant must secure one of the first three positions among girl students in the Rajasthan Board Class 10 examination.

faqs.q: How many students are selected each year?
faqs.a: A maximum of three girl students are selected every year, subject to consent availability.

faqs.q: How to apply for the scheme?
faqs.a: The application process is offline and applications must be submitted to the District Education Officer.

faqs.q: How to download the application form?
faqs.a: The application form can be downloaded from the official guideline document available on the education department portal.

Rajasthan.title: Rajasthan Widow / Abandoned Women B.Ed Fee Reimbursement Scheme
Rajasthan.overview: The Government of Rajasthan provides financial assistance to widowed or abandoned women pursuing B.Ed (Bachelor of Education) courses. Under this scheme, the state reimburses the B.Ed course fee to eligible women students studying in government or recognized private institutions, helping them become financially independent through education.
benefits: ₹17,880 fee reimbursement for B.Ed course
Financial support for widowed and abandoned women
Encourages higher education and self-reliance
Applicable for government and recognized private institutes in Rajasthan
eligibility: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Rajasthan
Only widowed or abandoned women are eligible
Applicant must be enrolled as a regular student in a B.Ed course
B.Ed institute must be government or recognized private institute in Rajasthan
Women who have already completed B.Ed earlier are not eligible
Minimum 75% attendance in the institute is mandatory
Applicant should not be receiving benefits from any other scholarship or equivalent government scheme
applicationProcess: Visit the official Rajasthan SSO portal
If not registered, complete SSO registration
Login using SSO ID and password
Select the Widow / Abandoned Women B.Ed Scheme
Fill the online application form carefully
Upload all required documents
Submit the application and save the acknowledgment details

faqs.q: What is this scheme?
faqs.a: This scheme provides fee reimbursement for B.Ed courses to widowed or abandoned women in Rajasthan.

faqs.q: What is the maximum reimbursement amount?
faqs.a: A maximum amount of ₹17,880 is reimbursed as B.Ed course fee.

faqs.q: Who can get the benefits of the scheme?
faqs.a: Widowed or abandoned women who are residents of Rajasthan and pursuing B.Ed as regular students.

faqs.q: Is this scheme only for women?
faqs.a: Yes, the scheme is exclusively for widowed or abandoned women.

faqs.q: Can a beneficiary avail other scholarships along with this scheme?
faqs.a: No, beneficiaries cannot avail any other scholarship or equivalent government scheme.

faqs.q: Can women from other states apply?
faqs.a: No, only Rajasthan domicile women are eligible.

faqs.q: How to apply for the scheme?
faqs.a: Applications must be submitted online through the Rajasthan SSO portal.

faqs.q: What documents are required?
faqs.a: Aadhaar card, domicile certificate, bank details, divorce or death certificate, fee receipt and educational documents.

faqs.q: What is the official portal to apply?
faqs.a: The official portal is https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/

Uttar Pradesh.title: Samaj Kalyan Vibhag Scholarship – Uttar Pradesh
Uttar Pradesh.overview: The Samaj Kalyan Vibhag Scholarship aims to provide financial support to students from economically weaker and disadvantaged communities in Uttar Pradesh, including SC, ST, OBC and General-EWS categories, to help them continue their education without financial burden.
benefits: Financial aid and maintenance allowance for students from disadvantaged backgrounds
Support for education from primary to higher and postgraduate levels
Helps reduce dropout rates among economically weaker students
eligibility: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh
Student must belong to a disadvantaged category (SC, ST, OBC, EWS) or be from low-income families
Student must be enrolled in a recognized school or college
Student must satisfy income and academic criteria as per official scholarship norms
applicationProcess: Visit the official Social Welfare / Samaj Kalyan Vibhag portal of UP
Navigate to the scholarship section
Register or login using your credentials
Fill out the scholarship application form with required details
Upload required academic, identity and income documents
Submit the form and save the acknowledgment for future reference
documentsRequired: Academic mark sheets and enrollment proof

faqs.q: What is the Samaj Kalyan Vibhag Scholarship?
faqs.a: It is a financial assistance scheme for students from disadvantaged communities to support their education from school to postgraduate level.

faqs.q: Who can apply for the scholarship?
faqs.a: Students who are permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh and meet the socio-economic and academic eligibility criteria.

faqs.q: How do I apply for the scholarship?
faqs.a: Applications are submitted online through the official Samaj Kalyan / Social Welfare Department portal of Uttar Pradesh.

sources: Department of Social Welfare, Uttar Pradesh
Samaj Kalyan Vibhag Scholarship official guidance

Uttar Pradesh.title: Uttar Pradesh Marriage Incentive Reward Scheme (Divyangjan)
Uttar Pradesh.overview: The Marriage Incentive Reward Scheme is a state-sponsored welfare scheme of the Government of Uttar Pradesh. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to differently-abled (Divyangjan) citizens to encourage their marriage and social empowerment. The marriage must be legally registered and at least one member of the couple should be a person with disability.
benefits: ₹15,000 incentive if the groom (man) is differently-abled
₹20,000 incentive if the bride (woman) is differently-abled
₹35,000 incentive if both bride and groom are differently-abled
One-time financial assistance directly to the beneficiary
eligibility: Applicant(s) must be permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh or domiciled for at least 5 years
At least one member of the couple must have a minimum of 40% disability
Marriage must be registered with the State Registrar
Neither spouse should have been convicted in any criminal case
Bride’s age must be between 18 and 45 years at the time of marriage
Groom’s age must be between 21 and 45 years at the time of marriage
Neither spouse should be an income tax payer
applicationProcess: Visit the official Social Welfare Department portal of Uttar Pradesh
Click on the registration option for the Marriage Incentive Reward Scheme
Fill in the online application form with required details
Provide information about type and percentage of disability
Enter details such as couple’s name, address and marriage registration certificate
Submit the online application form
Take a printout of the application
Submit the hard copy to the District Disabled Empowerment Office within 15 days
documentsRequired: Age Proof of bride and groom

faqs.q: What is the scope of this scheme?
faqs.a: The scheme encourages the marriage of differently-abled citizens by providing financial incentives and promoting social inclusion.

faqs.q: Who can get the benefits under the scheme?
faqs.a: Divyangjan couples where at least one member has a minimum 40% disability and fulfills the eligibility criteria.

faqs.q: Is there any minimum disability percentage required?
faqs.a: Yes, a minimum of 40% disability is mandatory.

faqs.q: Can couples from other states apply?
faqs.a: No, only permanent residents or domiciled citizens of Uttar Pradesh can apply.

faqs.q: What is the financial eligibility?
faqs.a: Neither spouse should be an income tax payer.

faqs.q: How to apply for the scheme?
faqs.a: Applications are submitted online, followed by mandatory submission of a hard copy to the District Disabled Empowerment Office.

faqs.q: What documents are required?
faqs.a: Age proof, address proof, disability certificate, marriage certificate and photographs are required.

Uttar Pradesh.title: Uttar Pradesh Pre Examination Training Centers Scheme
Uttar Pradesh.overview: The Uttar Pradesh Social Welfare Department has established Pre Examination Training Centers to provide high-quality coaching for UPSC, UPPSC and other competitive examinations to candidates from Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST) and Other Backward Classes (OBC) in the state. These centers aim to enhance educational equality and social justice by supporting economically and socially disadvantaged students.
benefits: Free coaching for competitive exams such as UPSC and UPPSC
Expert faculty guidance and classroom sessions
Mock tests, interview preparation and doubt-clearing sessions
Special facilities and reservations for women candidates at certain centers
Capacities to train over 1000 aspirants across multiple centers
eligibility: Candidate must be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh
Candidate must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST) or Other Backward Class (OBC)
Candidate should have passed a bachelor’s degree from a recognized university
Family annual income should be within limits specified by the department
applicationProcess: Visit the official Samaj Kalyan Vibhag portal of Uttar Pradesh
Check the notification for Pre Examination Training Centers
Fill in the application form with personal and educational details
Upload required documents including caste certificate and income certificate
Submit the application online or follow instructions for offline submission
Await selection details and attend counseling if required
centers: Lucknow – Shri Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj Research & Training Institute, Gomti Nagar
Lucknow – Model Pre Examination Centre (Girls), Aliganj
Varanasi – Sant Ravidas IAS/PCS Pre-Exam Training Centre
Aligarh – Dr. B.R. Ambedkar IAS/PCS Training Centre

faqs.q: What is the Pre Examination Training Centers scheme?
faqs.a: It is a government initiative by the Uttar Pradesh Social Welfare Department to provide free coaching for competitive exams to socially and economically disadvantaged students.

faqs.q: Who can apply for this scheme?
faqs.a: Students belonging to SC, ST or OBC communities who are permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh and have completed a bachelor’s degree.

faqs.q: What exams does the coaching cover?
faqs.a: The coaching covers civil service exams such as UPSC, UPPSC and other state and central competitive exams.

faqs.q: Are there special facilities for women?
faqs.a: Yes, some centers provide special facilities and reserved seats for women candidates.

faqs.q: Is the coaching free?
faqs.a: Yes, coaching is provided free of cost to eligible candidates under this scheme.

sources: Samaj Kalyan Department – UP Official Portal (Pre Examination Training Centers)
Social Welfare Department, Uttar Pradesh – Scheme Details

Madhya Pradesh.title: Madhya Pradesh Pre Examination Training / Free Coaching Scheme
Madhya Pradesh.department: Social Justice & Disabled Welfare Department, Madhya Pradesh
Madhya Pradesh.overview: The Government of Madhya Pradesh runs Pre Examination Training and Free Coaching schemes to provide quality coaching for competitive examinations such as UPSC, MPPSC and other state and central level exams. This scheme aims to support students from Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Other Backward Classes (OBC) and Minority communities by offering free coaching and academic guidance.
benefits: Free coaching for UPSC, MPPSC and other competitive examinations
Guidance from experienced faculty members
Mock tests, study material and interview preparation
Special support for economically weaker students
Residential and non-residential coaching facilities at selected centers
eligibility: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh
Applicant must belong to SC, ST, OBC or Minority community
Candidate should have passed Graduation from a recognized university
Annual family income should be within limits prescribed by the state government
Applicant should not be availing similar coaching benefits from another government scheme
applicationProcess: Visit the official Social Justice Department or Tribal Welfare Department portal of Madhya Pradesh
Check the notification related to Free Coaching / Pre Examination Training Scheme
Fill the application form with personal, educational and category details
Upload required documents such as caste certificate and income certificate
Submit the application online or offline as instructed
Wait for merit list / counseling information
centers: Bhopal – State Level Free Coaching Centre

faqs.q: What is the objective of this scheme?
faqs.a: The scheme aims to provide free coaching to disadvantaged students of Madhya Pradesh for competitive examinations.

faqs.q: Who can apply for this scheme?
faqs.a: Students belonging to SC, ST, OBC or Minority communities who are residents of Madhya Pradesh.

faqs.q: Which exams are covered under this coaching scheme?
faqs.a: UPSC, MPPSC and other state and central government competitive exams.

faqs.q: Is the coaching free of cost?
faqs.a: Yes, selected candidates are provided coaching free of cost.

faqs.q: Are women candidates given any preference?
faqs.a: Yes, as per government norms, preference may be given to women candidates.

sources: Social Justice & Disabled Welfare Department, Madhya Pradesh

Madhya Pradesh.title: सुपर 5000 (कक्षा 10वीं) प्रोत्साहन योजना
Madhya Pradesh.overview: मध्य प्रदेश श्रम विभाग द्वारा संचालित सुपर 5000 (कक्षा 10वीं) योजना के अंतर्गत वैध पंजीकृत निर्माण श्रमिक के पुत्र एवं पुत्री को शैक्षणिक प्रोत्साहन दिया जाता है। इस योजना का उद्देश्य निर्माण श्रमिकों के बच्चों को उच्च शिक्षा के लिए प्रेरित करना है।
benefits: ₹25,000 की एकमुश्त प्रोत्साहन राशि
राशि जीवनकाल में केवल एक बार प्रदान की जाती है
प्रत्यक्ष लाभार्थी के बैंक खाते में भुगतान
eligibility: आवेदक वैध परिचय-पत्रधारी पंजीकृत निर्माण श्रमिक का पुत्र या पुत्री होना चाहिए
मध्य प्रदेश माध्यमिक शिक्षा मंडल द्वारा आयोजित कक्षा 10वीं परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण हो
कक्षा 10वीं की संपूर्ण राज्य मेरिट सूची में प्रथम 5000 विद्यार्थियों में स्थान प्राप्त किया हो
शासकीय विद्यालय में अध्ययनरत अथवा स्वाध्यायी विद्यार्थी होना चाहिए
आवेदक की आयु 13 वर्ष या उससे अधिक हो
applicationProcess: योजना हेतु आवेदन संबंधित विद्यालय के प्राचार्य के माध्यम से किया जा सकता है
या फिर संभाग / जिला श्रम कार्यालय में आवेदन प्रस्तुत किया जा सकता है
आवेदन पत्र के साथ सभी आवश्यक दस्तावेज संलग्न करें
सत्यापन के बाद प्रकरण स्वीकृति हेतु सक्षम अधिकारी को भेजा जाता है
Madhya Pradesh.applicationDeadline: जिस वर्ष परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण की गई हो, उसके आगामी वर्ष के 31 मार्च तक
documentsRequired: निर्माण श्रमिक का वैध पंजीयन परिचय पत्र
Madhya Pradesh.approvalAuthority: सहायक श्रमायुक्त / श्रम पदाधिकारी / सहायक श्रम पदाधिकारी

faqs.q: सुपर 5000 योजना क्या है?
faqs.a: यह योजना निर्माण श्रमिकों के बच्चों को कक्षा 10वीं में उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन के लिए प्रोत्साहन राशि प्रदान करती है।

faqs.q: योजना के अंतर्गत कितनी राशि दी जाती है?
faqs.a: ₹25,000 की एकमुश्त प्रोत्साहन राशि दी जाती है।

faqs.q: क्या यह लाभ एक से अधिक बार मिल सकता है?
faqs.a: नहीं, यह लाभ जीवनकाल में केवल एक बार दिया जाता है।

faqs.q: आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि क्या है?
faqs.a: परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण करने के अगले वर्ष की 31 मार्च तक आवेदन किया जा सकता है।

faqs.q: कहां आवेदन किया जा सकता है?
faqs.a: संबंधित विद्यालय के प्राचार्य या जिला/संभाग श्रम कार्यालय में।

sources: श्रम विभाग, मध्य प्रदेश – आधिकारिक दिशा-निर्देश
निर्माण श्रमिक कल्याण बोर्ड, मध्य प्रदेश

Madhya Pradesh.title: लोक स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण विभाग – आगामी भर्ती कार्ययोजना
Madhya Pradesh.department: लोक स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण विभाग, मध्य प्रदेश
Madhya Pradesh.overview: मध्य प्रदेश शासन द्वारा लोक स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण विभाग में आगामी समय में लगभग 6,700 पदों पर भर्ती की कार्ययोजना तैयार की गई है। इस योजना का उद्देश्य स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं को सुदृढ़ करना तथा प्रदेश की जनता को गुणवत्तापूर्ण एवं समयबद्ध निःशुल्क स्वास्थ्य सुविधाएं उपलब्ध कराना है।

details: खाद्य एवं औषधि प्रशासन के 04 पद

benefits: चिकित्सक, विशेषज्ञ एवं पैरामेडिकल स्टाफ को सरकारी भर्ती का अवसर
शिक्षित एवं तकनीकी वर्ग के लिए रोजगार सृजन
प्रदेश की जनता को निःशुल्क एवं गुणवत्तापूर्ण स्वास्थ्य सेवाएं
समय पर चिकित्सा उपचार एवं बेहतर स्वास्थ्य ढांचा
Madhya Pradesh.ageGroup: शासन द्वारा निर्धारित नियमों के अनुसार
eligibility: संबंधित पद के अनुसार आवश्यक शैक्षणिक योग्यता
चिकित्सा एवं तकनीकी पदों के लिए मान्यता प्राप्त संस्थान से डिग्री / डिप्लोमा
अन्य पात्रता शर्तें विभागीय भर्ती नियमों के अनुसार लागू होंगी
applicationProcess: लोक स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण विभाग की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट पर भर्ती अधिसूचना जारी की जाएगी
पदवार पात्रता एवं आवेदन प्रक्रिया की जानकारी अधिसूचना में दी जाएगी
योग्य उम्मीदवार ऑनलाइन आवेदन कर सकेंगे
चयन प्रक्रिया में लिखित परीक्षा / साक्षात्कार / दस्तावेज सत्यापन शामिल हो सकता है

faqs.q: इस भर्ती कार्ययोजना के अंतर्गत कितने पद भरे जाएंगे?
faqs.a: इस योजना के अंतर्गत कुल 6,700 पदों पर भर्ती प्रस्तावित है।

faqs.q: किन-किन श्रेणियों के पद शामिल हैं?
faqs.a: प्रथम, द्वितीय, तृतीय एवं चतुर्थ श्रेणी के पद शामिल हैं।

faqs.q: क्या यह स्थायी सरकारी भर्ती होगी?
faqs.a: भर्ती की प्रकृति एवं सेवा शर्तें आधिकारिक अधिसूचना में स्पष्ट की जाएंगी।

faqs.q: आवेदन कब से शुरू होंगे?
faqs.a: आवेदन तिथि शासन द्वारा अधिसूचना जारी होने के बाद घोषित की जाएगी।

sources: लोक स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण विभाग, मध्य प्रदेश – आधिकारिक सूचना
मध्य प्रदेश शासन – भर्ती कार्ययोजना विवरण

Bihar.title: Chief Minister Divyangjan Empowerment Scheme (Sambal)
Bihar.overview: Chief Minister Divyangjan Empowerment Scheme (Sambal) का उद्देश्य राज्य के दिव्यांग नागरिकों को शारीरिक, सामाजिक, शैक्षणिक और आर्थिक रूप से सशक्त बनाना है। इस योजना के अंतर्गत दिव्यांगजन कल्याण से जुड़ी विभिन्न राज्य एवं राष्ट्रीय योजनाओं का लाभ त्वरित रूप से प्रदान किया जाता है।
benefits: स्वरोजगार हेतु ₹2,00,000 तक का ऋण
विशेष विद्यालयों में शिक्षण हेतु छात्रवृत्ति
राष्ट्रीय ट्रस्ट की योजनाओं में राज्य अनुदान
कृत्रिम अंग एवं सहायक उपकरण हेतु सहायता
विशेष परिस्थितियों में अतिरिक्त अनुदान
eligibility: स्वरोजगार ऋण हेतु आयु सीमा 18 से 60 वर्ष
कृत्रिम अंग एवं उपकरण हेतु न्यूनतम आयु 5 वर्ष
विशेष विद्यालय हेतु आयु सीमा 6 से 18 वर्ष
आश्रय गृह (Ashiyana / Saket) हेतु न्यूनतम आयु 18 वर्ष
विशेष मामलों में आय एवं आयु सीमा लागू नहीं
applicationProcess: आधिकारिक पोर्टल पर जाएं
ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण करें
लॉगिन कर आवेदन फॉर्म भरें
फोटो, हस्ताक्षर एवं आवश्यक दस्तावेज अपलोड करें
आवेदन सबमिट करें

faqs.q: Sambal योजना क्या है?
faqs.a: यह बिहार सरकार की दिव्यांगजन सशक्तिकरण योजना है।

faqs.q: क्या अन्य राज्य के नागरिक आवेदन कर सकते हैं?
faqs.a: नहीं, यह योजना केवल बिहार के निवासियों के लिए है।

Bihar.title: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme
Bihar.overview: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme का उद्देश्य आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर छात्रों को उच्च शिक्षा के लिए वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना है। इस योजना के तहत छात्र ₹4 लाख तक का शिक्षा ऋण प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।
benefits: तकनीकी, सामान्य एवं व्यावसायिक पाठ्यक्रमों हेतु ऋण
किताबें, लैपटॉप एवं फीस हेतु उपयोग
कोर्स पूरा होने एवं नौकरी मिलने के बाद पुनर्भुगतान
दिव्यांग, ट्रांसजेंडर एवं छात्राओं हेतु 1% ब्याज दर
eligibility: आवेदक बिहार का निवासी हो

faqs.q: BSCC योजना का लाभ कौन ले सकता है?
faqs.a: बिहार के वे छात्र जिन्होंने 12वीं उत्तीर्ण की है।

faqs.q: अधिकतम ऋण राशि कितनी है?

Bihar.title: Mukhyamantri Prakhand Parivahan Yojana
Bihar.overview: Mukhyamantri Prakhand Parivahan Yojana का उद्देश्य बिहार के दूरदराज़ क्षेत्रों को जिला मुख्यालय से जोड़ना तथा रोजगार सृजन को बढ़ावा देना है। इस योजना के अंतर्गत बस खरीद हेतु सब्सिडी प्रदान की जाती है।
benefits: प्रति बस ₹5,00,000 की सब्सिडी
ग्रामीण एवं ब्लॉक स्तर पर परिवहन सुविधा
SC, ST, EBC, BC, Minority वर्ग को प्रोत्साहन
स्वरोजगार के अवसर
eligibility: आवेदक संबंधित ब्लॉक का निवासी हो
न्यूनतम आयु 18 वर्ष
वैध ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस
सरकारी कर्मचारी नहीं होना चाहिए
applicationProcess: परिवहन विभाग की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट पर जाएं

faqs.q: प्रति ब्लॉक कितने लाभार्थी चुने जाते हैं?
faqs.a: सरकारी दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार चयन किया जाता है।

faqs.q: सब्सिडी कैसे दी जाती है?
faqs.a: चयन के बाद सीधे लाभार्थी को।
